## Purpose

Capture or select a photograph with scale and measurement context. Select gridspaces to highlight features and return both annotated and unannotated versions.

## Capability IDs

- `scaled_photo.capture`

## Requirements

- Camera or image-selection access.

**From `example_odk_scaled_photo.capture.xlsx`:**

``` text

```
